title: Read-only global ECOUNT REA recreation coverage audit
method: Flattened actual dist/menus.json with existing MenuCore.indexMenus; 759 unique route IDs, 248 item-level + 511 child rows.
Followed actual app.js dispatch precedence: SelfUI then ApiUI then Inventory I or MyPage name alias, else scope card.
Used existing InventoryCore.resolve for all effective inventory routes and inspected UI branches, dedicated modules and original-evidence docs.
Read-only bounded audit; did not run write-producing tests, mutate ERP, access credentials, or count prior completion assertions/render tests as equivalence.

Dedicated classification is deliberately conservative: requires identifiable screen-specific implementation and traceable observed/public-source evidence. Original-informed generic helpers do not make every screen dedicated.

categoryDefinitions.menu_only_placeholder: Route opens common menu confirmation/scope card with no domain business implementation.
categoryDefinitions.generic_independent_implementation: Functional independent CRUD/report/form/settings/API/simulation or generic hub; some have shared REA-informed helpers/source anchors, but complete route-specific original UI/client contract is not established.
categoryDefinitions.observed_or_analyzed_dedicated_partial: Specific original-observed or analyzed treatment is traceable to this route and executable dispatcher; all remain partial with stated limits. Aliases counted as routes, not unique screens.

dispatchFindings.detail: All nine MyPage routes map by exact leaf name to first matching Inventory I row; no separate MyPage business implementation.
1-2-2 matches both SelfUI.has and ApiUI.has, but app.js calls SelfUI first: actual route is menu-pair mapping in SelfSettingsUI, not API center. API UI is effectively reached at 1-0-2.
2-6-2 is a generic inventory hub; dedicated E040701 stock implementation is only 2-6-2-0. Hub derived report name is 재고현황현황 and does not trigger exact-name dedicated stock dispatch.
InventoryCore.resolve assigns every Inventory I row a handler using names/regex, and renderCurrent dispatches by kind. Many distinct original reports share one independent model.

Inventory I business data remains per-user browser storage, separate from D1 gateway API business state. Settings/accounts are server-backed; route coverage does not establish multi-user company ledger consistency.

Purchase-room workflow, reconciliation, serial/assets and month-close modules are available via Inventory I toolbar. They do not implement placeholder Inventory II, accounting, tax or management routes.

crossCuttingUnsupported: Original ECOUNT backend authentication, session, transactions, concurrency, permissions and per-company policies.
Original ECOUNT API wire compatibility, authentication keys and real calls; current provider catalog is semantic reference only.
External tax invoice issue, finance posting, banks/cards, payroll delivery, mail, messaging, electronic approval, ecommerce adapters and scheduled sends.
Original cost/FIFO/monthly valuation, all tax/legal calculations, WMS/quality/lot and serial domain server rules.
Complete original condition/form designer, button settings, attachments/uploads/images/history/delete recovery, dynamic templates, all print/Excel options.
Hosted post-login business QA, real mobile/printer/scanner QA not established by local synthetic evidence.
REA CLI complete application graph remains blocked in recent iterations by process-ownership inspection; in-process inert static/semantic analyses are narrower evidence.

nextImplementationOpportunities.preciseGap: barcodeComparison keys expected and scanned maps only by line.item. Original evidence explicitly defines PROD_CD plus conditional PROD_DES/SIZE_DES when DES_INC/SIZE_INC enabled.
nextImplementationOpportunities.boundedWork: Add opt-in name/spec comparison keys and matching scan-grid fields, preserve default code-only behavior and avoid rewriting the draft. Independently validate duplicates, missing/extra rows, mismatch and name/spec cases.
nextImplementationOpportunities.stillUnknown: Hardware scanner behavior and company-default flags remain unverified.

nextImplementationOpportunities.preciseGap: Original popup was directly observed with three sort rows, page separation, subtotal and total controls. Current openSort supplies only the first sort row and one aggregate total; remaining controls disabled.
nextImplementationOpportunities.boundedWork: Implement deterministic three-key ordering and opt-in subtotal/total rendering from the existing snapshot with clear independent rules; preserve exactly five basic result columns and cancel semantics.
nextImplementationOpportunities.stillUnknown: Observe unresolved detail popups and establish original subtotal aggregation semantics before claiming ECOUNT compatibility; page print behavior needs separate verification.

nextImplementationOpportunities.preciseGap: Analyzed stockReport onInitUnitGridCellOutStanding links out_bal/in_bal/pr_bal to unsold/unpurchased/unproduced status with item/date/warehouse context. Dedicated current stock UI only exposes five basic columns and own movement ledger.
nextImplementationOpportunities.boundedWork: First directly inspect original relevant outstanding report layout and interactions, then implement context-preserving drilldowns using own documented remaining-quantity policies.
nextImplementationOpportunities.stillUnknown: Dynamic form column activation, target report filters, server remaining and warehouse policies.

nextImplementationOpportunities.preciseGap: Observed request to plan to order to purchase pages retain disabled transaction type, unit/box conversions, history/upload/delete/recovery, attachments and external sends. Purchasing auxiliary reports remain generic.
nextImplementationOpportunities.boundedWork: Follow repository priority request -> plan -> order -> purchase, directly inspect missing picker/submenu/popups read-only, analyze the actual public module, define conversion/backups for every schema change.
nextImplementationOpportunities.stillUnknown: Most detailed subflows; do not implement guessed original buttons or original mutation results.

nextImplementationOpportunities.preciseGap: Inventory II serial/lot routes are scope cards despite a separate purchase-room serial/asset feature. That feature is not an ECOUNT serial module and not mounted at the corresponding routes.
nextImplementationOpportunities.boundedWork: Use existing independent asset module as internal capability inventory only; directly observe original serial/lot screens and analyze public modules before creating an actual route implementation.
nextImplementationOpportunities.stillUnknown: Original serial default 0/1, expiry/purchase linkage schema, lot tracking and original layout/server constraints.
